problems: The blind guess (arrow, bird, or angular abstract figure) does not identify shears. The closest alternative, a V or tweezers, is partial at best. The figure reads as an X with a pendant V rather than a pair of scissors.

Stars are roughly on the intended parts: both ring-handle stars sit at the top, the rivet is at the crossing, and the two blade tips are at the bottom. However, the handles are small concentric rings with no clear loop shape, so they do not read as finger rings.
The left blade line runs from the left handle through the rivet, but the lower-left tip is a separate short segment. The blades do not read as two distinct, parallel blades meeting at a pivot.

Labels collide and are clipped: 'centre of the left ring hand' and 'centre of the right ring han' are cut off, 'the rivet where the two blad' is truncated, and 'lower-left blade tip' overlaps the rivet and blade lines.
The figure is drawn as blue and gold double lines along star-to-star edges. It is not a silhouette, so it reads as a wireframe of the star connections rather than an object outline.
Orientation is acceptable: handles up, blades pointing down, which is a natural upright pose for shears.
output.advice: Redraw so the figure reads as a pair of shears. (1) Make the two ring handles clear loops: place the star for the left handle (66249) and the right handle (64238) at the top of two open ring shapes, and offset them so the rings are visibly separate. (2) Keep the rivet (65474) at the exact crossing point of the two blades, and lengthen both blades so they extend well past it. (3) Place the lower-left blade tip (65639) and lower-right blade tip (64407) at the ends of two distinct, roughly parallel blade lines that emerge from the rivet, so each blade is a clear segment. (4) Shorten or move the part labels so none are clipped or overlapping: put the handle labels above the rings, the rivet label to one side, and the blade-tip labels below the tips. (5) Render as a filled or outlined silhouette with the star-to-star lines as a secondary layer, so the object shape is the dominant visual. Keep the title 'Mesil — the Wick Shears' as is.
